title: Imports (Java + Spark)
description: Standard Java I/O and collections, plus Apache Spark SQL and MLlib imports for datasets, sessions, and the Linear SVC classifier.

reflection.items: Take a close look at the imports in this chunk. (a) What do you think the overall purpose of these import lines is? (b) Based on the names, what do you think the Spark-related libraries do when used in the program? Please write at least a few sentences for each part.

title: Class doc + ModelComponents inner class
description: The main class documentation and a helper class that bundles all fitted ML stages (tokenizer, stop words, TF-IDF, SVC model) for passing between methods.

title: Constants
description: Configuration constants: CSV path, train/test split ratio (80/20), and a fixed random seed for reproducible splits.

title: main: banner + Spark init + try
description: Entry point prints a banner, initializes the Spark session, and starts the try block that will run the full pipeline.

title: main: pipeline steps 1–6
description: The six high-level steps: load and prepare data, split into train/test, train the model, make predictions, evaluate, and test on sample reviews.

title: Step 1: load and prepare
description: First pipeline step: load and prepare data.

title: Steps 2–3: split and train
description: Split data and train the model.

title: main: catch/finally + completion
description: Error handling and cleanup: catch logs errors, finally stops the Spark session, then prints the completion banner.

title: initializeSpark()
description: Creates a local Spark session with config that disables adaptive execution and console progress for cleaner, predictable runs.

title: loadAndPrepareData()
description: Loads the CSV via loadData(), prints sample count, and shows the class distribution (positive vs negative labels).

title: splitData()
description: Splits the dataset into training and test sets using a fixed seed. Uses TEST_SIZE (0.2) for 80% train / 20% test.

title: trainModel() — stage definitions
description: Defines the ML pipeline stages: Tokenizer, StopWordsRemover, HashingTF, IDF, and Linear SVC. Each is configured with input/output column names.

title: trainModel() — fitting pipeline
description: Runs training data through the transformers, fits IDF and Linear SVC on train only, then returns a ModelComponents bundle for use in prediction.

title: makePredictions()
description: Applies the same tokenizer, stop words, HashingTF, and fitted IDF and SVC to the test set to produce predictions.

title: loadData()
description: Reads the CSV with a fixed schema (text, sentiment), then converts sentiment strings to numeric labels (positive=1, negative=0).

title: evaluateModel()
description: Computes accuracy, precision, recall, F1; prints a metrics table, performance interpretation, and the confusion matrix with detailed counts.

title: getConfusionMatrix()
description: Collects predictions and builds a 2×2 confusion matrix, handling both Integer and Double label types from Spark.

title: testSampleReviews()
description: Runs the trained model on a fixed list of sample reviews, compares predicted vs expected sentiment, and prints a table with accuracy.
